up: List the ChEMBL IDs and canonical SMILES for all compounds associated with the document having ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL3886604'. Join the docs table to compound_records on doc_id, then join molecule_dictionary and compound_structures on molregno. Return distinct rows with columns: molecule_dictionary.chembl_id and compound_structures.canonical_smiles.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON cr.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3886604'
